headline: Profit jumps year over year, eases from last quarter
summary_short: Revenue of $3,104M was up 27.0% y/y but down 4.1% q/q; net income of $1,002M rose 49.8% y/y while easing 21.8% q/q from an exceptionally strong prior quarter.
summary_long: Revenue reached $3,104M, up 27.0% y/y but down 4.1% q/q. Gross profit was $1,703M (+42.3% y/y, -12.3% q/q) and operating income $1,583M (+58.5% y/y, -12.7% q/q). EBIT and EBITDA both came in at $1,698M, up 55.8% y/y but down 16.7% q/q. Net income of $1,002M rose 49.8% y/y yet fell 21.8% q/q. EPS was $1.97 (+49.2% y/y, -21.8% q/q); diluted EPS $1.96 (+48.5% y/y, -21.9% q/q). No cash-position figure is available on the shard.
